articles.title: Bank Rate Pressure Puts Barclays Lloyds And NatWest Shares In Focus
articles.summary: The Bank of England is preparing to lift the Bank Rate again, and that shift in the price of money could quietly reshape the outlook for UK domestic banks and lenders. Rate moves change what borrowers pay and what depositors earn, which can alter how these businesses make money and manage risk. This article unpacks that story and highlights 3 UK banking stocks that are closely tied to this rate decision. The three stocks that follow are just a starting sample, since the full screen surfaced...

articles.title: NatWest Group (LSE:NWG) Stock Faces Q3 Earnings Margin And Loan Book Questions
articles.summary: NatWest Group closed Friday at £5.796, rounding off a bruising stretch that left the share price down about 20% over three months and roughly 13% over the past month. That weak tape met a punchy Q3 2026 earnings print, with basic earnings per share at £0.193 and a reported net interest margin of 2.5% that underpins the core banking engine. The real story sits on the balance sheet, though. Total loans reached £464.9b, raising the question of how investors should weigh short-term price pressure...
